title: Wait before multiplying
prompt: The local source returns Promise<number>. Read it once and resolve with twice its value, including zero and negative numbers.
hints: Read the compiler message about the arithmetic operand.
Which expression returns the future result?
Get the number with await before multiplying.
checks: await (async()=>{let calls=0; await doubled(async()=>++calls); return calls===1;})()
feedback: Read the compiler message about the arithmetic operand.
